answer: Stamp each agent's work with a slow hash-based **cipher** keyed to its identity, then publish it on a shared ledger so duplicate identities can't reuse proof. New agents must anchor at the **wharf** — a bonding dock where stake locks before first vote — and every endorsement sends a **ripple** up the sponsor chain: forging a sybil swarm costs the attacker real stake plus collateral slashed if any downstream ripple diverges.
